text.p: Following are the main stories in Thursday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Solomon Islands is encouraging Malaysian entrepreneurs to invest in 18 projects, ranging from making matches to hotel and resort development
- The Sapura Group is believed to be holding discussions with Permodalan Nasional Bhd to purchase a major stake in UMW Holdings Bhd
- Several houseowners who had converted their houses into multi-room hostels ordered their tenants to leave within 24 hours on Wednesday and started tearing down their illegal structures
